description: Stretch one arm out with your palm facing forward and pull your fingers back for 10 seconds per hand.
Stretch your arm across your chest and pull it with your other arm for 10 seconds per side.
Using your hand, gently pull your neck to the right and to the left, holding each position for a few seconds.
Place both hands behind your head and gently bring it down, stretching the back of your neck.
Cross your legs and reach down toward the floor with arms extended. Repeat with the other leg in front.
Sitting down, spread your legs and try to place your palms flat on the floor. Repeat 3 times for 5 seconds each.
Pull your knee toward your chest and hold it, then switch legs after 10 seconds.
Sitting down, cross one leg and lean your torso forward. Switch legs after 10 seconds.
Sitting down, close your eyes and cover them with your palms for 2 minutes, then open them normally.
In an open space, look as far as you can in four directions for 3 seconds each, moving only your eyes. Repeat 3 times.
Using your thumbs, massage the area below your eyebrows in circular motions for 15 seconds.
Standing up, rotate your waist as far as you can to the left and hold for five seconds. Repeat to the right.
